state.emptyHint: This area shows real data only; right now there is none.

errors._unknown: That did not work ({code}). Nothing was changed.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something failed inside Anvil; the operation did not complete.
errors.CONFIG_CONFLICT: This configuration changed elsewhere, so your change was not written. Reload, then save again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That item was not found. It may have been deleted or moved.
errors.PROTOCOL_RECORD_TOO_LARGE: A single record exceeded the size limit and was rejected.
errors.UNSUPPORTED: This build does not support that operation.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.VERIFICATION_FAILED: Verification failed, so the result was not accepted.
errors.NEEDS_HUMAN: This step needs your confirmation before it can continue.
errors.CREDENTIAL_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The system credential store is unavailable, so the secret cannot be saved safely.
errors.STALE_SNAPSHOT: This data is out of date. Refresh and try again.
errors.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Outcome unknown: the operation may or may not have taken effect. Check before retrying.
errors.CONTROL_UNCERTAIN: The stop/interrupt result is uncertain; the run state must be read again.
errors.CLEANUP_FAILED: Cleanup failed; temporary files may remain.
errors.MISSING_REQUIRED_CASE: A required acceptance case is missing.
errors.STALE_REVISION: Revision mismatch: your copy is behind.
errors.REPORT_HASH_MISMATCH: Report digest mismatch; the evidence is not trustworthy.
errors.REVIEWER_MISSING: The reviewer and review record are missing.
errors.EMPTY_SUITE: The suite contained no cases, so it cannot pass.
errors.ALL_SKIPPED: Every case was skipped, so this cannot pass.
errors.RUNNER_MISSING: No runner was found, so nothing actually ran.
errors.DEPENDENCY_MISSING: A dependency is missing. Add the model, skill or credential it needs first.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests; you are being rate limited. Try again later.
errors.PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE: Cannot reach the model endpoint. Check the network and the endpoint URL.
errors.PROVIDER_ERROR: The model endpoint returned an error.
errors.RPC_TIMEOUT: Talking to Pi timed out and will not be replayed (it may have partly taken effect).
errors.RPC_CANCELLED: The call to Pi was cancelled.
errors.RPC_WRITE_FAILED: Writing the request to Pi failed.
errors.RPC_INVALID_CALL: The call to Pi was malformed.
errors.RPC_COMMAND_FAILED: Pi reported that the command failed.
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: This run used up its budget (tool calls or elapsed time).
errors.COMPATIBILITY: The installed Pi version does not speak this app's protocol.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid input: {field} value {value} is not supported. Allowed: {supported}.

workbench.title: Workbench

workbench.unavailable: Source unavailable: no number is shown, so “cannot read” is not mistaken for “none”.

search.title: Global search
search.placeholder: Search pages, sessions, agents, skills, artifacts
search.tooShort: Type at least 3 characters to search.
search.indexUnavailable: The search index has not been built yet: rebuild it to search sessions and resources.

notImplemented.title: Not implemented
notImplemented.connectors: Connectors are not implemented locally yet. Only real state is shown; there is no action that fakes success.

chat.emptyHint: Type the first message below. Tool calls and approvals appear here in backend event order.
chat.settledHint: The outcome comes only from the backend terminal event; a finished tool call does not end the run.

tool.title: Tool call
tool.unknownHint: After a stop or interruption this call never reported a result: neither success nor failure is claimed.

approval.title: Permission required
approval.pendingHint: A click only submits the request; this card disappears when the backend approval.resolved arrives.
approval.resolvedSession: The backend allowed it for this session

clarification.title: Your answer is needed
clarification.question: Question
clarification.pendingHint: This is a content question, not a tool permission: answering it grants no tool or site access.
clarification.expired: Timed out; the backend closed it as cancelled

composer.placeholder: Describe what you want done (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line)
composer.stopRequested: Stop requested: no new message is dispatched until the backend settles the run.
composer.profileHint: The backend decides which Profile this run uses
composer.modelHint: Snapshot at start; changing the model affects the next run only
composer.attachmentsHint: The backend resolves attachments: a path string is not authoritative; only backend-verified IDs and digests count.
composer.pathPlaceholder: Paste a local file or directory path
composer.skillPick: Pick a managed Skill to attach

context.title: Context
context.empty: Nothing to show for this run yet.
context.unavailable: This section cannot read backend data right now.
context.noRun: No run yet: send a message first.
context.hashDrifted: Changed: the file no longer matches the registered digest
context.hashMissing: Missing: the file is not on disk
context.usageUnavailable: The backend recorded no usage for this run
context.browserMissing: The browser section needs the B07 native binding: this backend exposes no browser state, so it shows unavailable only.
context.citationsMissing: The backend provides no citation records (RunDetails has no citations field), so this section shows unavailable only.

error.hintBudget: This run budget (tool calls or duration) is used up: retry or raise the budget, then send again.
error.hintCompatibility: The Pi version does not match this app protocol: upgrade Pi in settings, then retry.
error.hintProvider: The model service failed: check the model config and network, then retry.
error.hintGeneric: Check the error code and retry; nothing was changed by this step.

sessionActions.conflict: The session changed elsewhere (stale revision); nothing was written.
sessionActions.conflictHint: Reload this session, then try again.

chat.otherSessionRun: Another session is running: its messages and approvals belong to that session and are not shown here.

address.label: Page address
address.placeholder: Type a URL and press Enter

browser.stopHint: The stop button sits outside the native page area, so the page cannot cover it

control.takeOverHint: Hand control to the human: queued actions are revoked, dispatched input is not undone
control.resumeHint: The agent must observe a new snapshot before it can act again

slot.native: The native page is placed in this area (not an iframe, not a screenshot)
slot.occluded: The native page made room for an overlay; it comes back when the overlay closes (the agent is not paused)
slot.noHost: Native host unavailable: no page on the right

occlusion.hidden: Overlay open: the native page is hidden for now (hiding the panel is not pausing the agent)
